raw_prompt: Set the default lifetime to 7 days for new links in my URL shortener.

requirements.description: Create unique short codes for valid URLs.
Apply the normalized default link lifetime, allow shorter timezone-aware expirations, and reject redirects after expiry.
Resolve known short codes to their destination URLs.

unresolved_questions: What scale and service-level target should the first release support?
assumptions: Use a single-instance prototype target until scale requirements are clarified.
Use a 168-hour default lifetime and permit timezone-aware explicit expirations up to 168 hours.
